name: What is the cost of professional drywall repair?

mainEntity.name: What is the cost of professional drywall repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of professional drywall repair varies significantly based on the size and complexity of the damage, the type of texture, and accessibility. Minor repairs, like small holes, are less expensive than larger sections requiring new drywall and extensive finishing. Factors such as matching existing textures, painting, and the location of the damage (e.g., ceilings vs. walls) also influence the final price. We provide detailed estimates after an on-site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost depends on damage size, complexity, texture matching, and location. Minor repairs are less costly than larger, more involved projects.
